title: Peanut butter cookies
summary: Flourless peanut butter cookies with the classic fork crosshatch, dairy-free as written and ready in twenty minutes.

ingredients.note: skip if your peanut butter is salted

steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Stir all the ingredients together until thick and smooth.
Roll into 16 balls and set 5 cm (2 in) apart. Press each flat with a fork, then press again at right angles to make a crosshatch.
Bake 10–12 minutes, until the edges are just golden. The cookies are very soft when hot: leave them on the sheet for 15 minutes before moving.
tips: Use a no-stir-style peanut butter with only peanuts and salt; a very oily natural one makes the cookies spread.
Dip the fork in erythritol between cookies so it doesn't stick.

origin.history: Peanut butter became a common American food around the turn of the twentieth century, and peanut butter cookies were printed in US cookbooks in the early 1900s. By the 1930s the fork-pressed crosshatch, which flattens the stiff dough so it bakes evenly, had become the standard way to shape them.
